My goal is to share my knowledge,  experience, and personalized Feng Shui methods with you, so that you can create a home that supports the life that you want to live. My approach is not about creating the “perfect home”, because let’s face it, “perfect” is not an actual thing. But rather to bring more balance into your space and to create a home that fits and supports the real life that you lead. 

I truly believe that when your space supports you, you have more patience, more connection, and more energy for the people who matter most in your life. You have more peace and joy within yourself, and as a result you live a more fulfilled life. These are the things that I hope to bring into your space using Feng Shui principales combined with my practical and modern approach. 

I hope to connect with you all, and I’m so excited to welcome you to Harmony By Marta, the Podcast. I hope you enjoy.

The more I’ve asked this question, the more I’ve realised how differently we each interpret the word. I’ve been called resilient many times. Through honest conversations, I explore what resilience means to different people and how we might reframe it.

author: Chora Media - Daniele Franco
description:
La longevità è entrata nel nostro vocabolario quotidiano, raccontata quasi sempre con entusiasmo e raramente nella sua complessità. Ma vivere più a lungo non è solo una questione di anni in più: è una questione di senso. Che cosa facciamo di questo tempo guadagnato, come lo abitiamo, chi ne beneficia davvero, quali responsabilità comporta.


In questa serie promossa dalla Fondazione Giorgio Cini di Venezia, che ha posto il tema al centro delle sue iniziative per il 2026, Daniele Franco ne parla con alcune delle voci più autorevoli del panorama italiano, scelte  per le angolature diverse da cui la guardano. Perché una società che invecchia non è soltanto una società con più anziani: è una società che cambia il proprio rapporto con il tempo, con la cura e la morte, che si interroga sulla convivenza tra generazioni, sulla trasmissione delle conoscenze e del potere.

title: KNOW YOUR REAL ENEMY
author: John Godwin Eiza
description:
Text: "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." (Ephesians 6:12 KJV)

Keywords:
1. Wrestle Not
2. Not Flesh
3. Spiritual

Message: 
          Before you wear armour, you must know your enemy. "We wrestle not against flesh and blood." Many of our battles are misdirected. We fight spouses, children, bosses, neighbours, while the real enemy hides behind them. Paul pulls back the curtain: our fight is spiritual. Principalities, powers, rulers of darkness. This does not mean people are not involved, but they are not the source. When you understand this, you stop hating people and start praying against spirits. You stop using carnal weapons and pick up spiritual ones. Victory begins when you fight the right enemy on the right battlefield. Prayer Points:
- Father, open my eyes to see the real battle. - Forgive me for fighting people instead of praying for them. - Teach me to wrestle in the spirit, not in the flesh.

"For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." - Ephesians 6:12 KJV

Welcome to "Colorful Conversations with Alex Righetto," a captivating podcast that dives deep into the creative mind of an extraordinary Italian artist. Join Alex Righetto, a painter, photographer, and marketer, as he shares his passion for art and storytelling with listeners around the globe.
In each episode, Alex draws from his unique perspective, vibrant color palettes, and dynamic brushwork to explore the emotionally charged narratives behind his paintings. You'll be transported to a world where Italian heritage meets contemporary art, as Alex reinterprets elements from Italian and Europe

Michelle brings raw conversations, lived experience, humor, and hard-earned wisdom to the mic without pretending to have it all figured out. Nothing is off the table. We unpack it, learn from it, laugh when we can, and keep evolving.

We Said What We Said is a show where Gilbert Arenas, Nick Young, and Melli Monaco bring unfiltered opinions, hilarious conversations, wild stories, celebrity drama, viral moments, sports, culture, and everything happening in the world.
Nothing is off limits.
From the biggest celebrity headlines and the craziest videos taking over the internet to sports, relationships, community issues, politics, world news, and the conversations everyone is having — we break it all down with our own unique perspective.

title: Caregiving Reimagined
author: Dr. Claudia Bennett
description: My name is Dr. Claudia Cassidy Bennett. I've spent over 40 years as an occupational therapist, the last 15 working specifically with family caregivers navigating one of life's most demanding journeys. I've also lived this alongside you, caring for my own mother through Alzheimer's. I've learned what caregivers actually need: practical help, honest support, and someone who genuinely gets it. Until you’re part of the club, it’s hard to understand. We'll tackle the everyday challenges — bathing, dressing, feeding, toileting, medication management, and doctors’ appointments. We'll go deep into the emotional and spiritual side of caregiving that rarely gets talked about. You'll hear real stories from real caregivers. And yes — we'll laugh too. At the missteps, at the unexpected things our loved ones do, at the moments that are equal parts exhausting and absurd. The good, the bad, and the ugly. Because caregiving can be a messy job — physically and emotionally. Caregiving is not just something that happens to you. It is an opportunity to strengthen your relationship with your loved one, to deepen your spirituality, and to discover a level of self-awareness you never knew was possible. Being the caregiver you want to be — and are proud to be.

title: Think Like An Economist
author: iHeartPodcasts
description: Think Like an Economist and you'll see the world more clearly, empowering you to make better decisions at work, at home, and in your community. Leading economists Betsey Stevenson and Justin Wolfers will take you on a joyous romp through their field as they introduce you to the big ideas in economics, and show how you can apply them to live in your own life. Their signature approach reveals that every decision is an economic decision and this podcast uncovers the economic forces that shape the world around you. Betsey and Justin believe that economics is a superpower, and they want to teach you to fly.

Different conversations, different stories, all circling the same question: what’s the next smallest step?

author: SuperDifferent.com
description: SuperDifferent.com presents a podcast like no other—featuring Christian messages, scripture, prayer, poetry, and more to fuel your faith. In a world clouded by fear and moral darkness, recharge with hope and courage. You’ll also journey alongside Hanaya Oki, a teenage girl in Japan, as she navigates life with Jesus from her early to late teens. Though fictional, Hanaya is inspired by real teens of faith, and her story sparks deeper conversations about choices, purpose, and eternal perspective. Each episode draws you into her world while inviting you to look deeper into your own.

Three friends since the 90s (don't do the math) get together to talk about life, love, and whether you've got the equipment to handle it all. A weekly discussion of how AI moves from strategy to adoption.
Each episode begins with a Source (a concept, a decision, news, etc), and deep dives on what it reveals about how AI reshapes leadership, operations, and governance.

Every Monday a new episode https://thesourceaideepdive.netlify.app/

title: Encore: The Best is Yet to Come
author: Susannah Schofield OBE | Author, Entrepreneur & Host
description:
What happens when life gives you an Encore?
Hosted by Susannah Schofield OBE, Encore: The Best is Yet to Come is about what comes next, and making it count. Each week, Susannah sits down with a new guest, from leading experts and familiar faces to people with extraordinary real-life stories, for honest conversations about relationships, reinvention, confidence, health, intimacy, success and starting again.
No filters. No judgement. Just real people, real advice and the conversations we should be having after 40.
Your next chapter could be your best one yet!

title: Treat It Or Train It
author: Justin Harris and Justin Feldman
description: Treat It or Train It? is the show for anyone caught between the foam roller and the finish line. Each week, physical therapist Dr. Justin Feldman, PT, DPT (Feldman Physical Therapy & Performance) and endurance coach Justin Harris (jHarris Coaching) take real questions from listeners — submitted as video — and settle the debate: is this an injury to treat, or a limitation to train through? One clinical eye, one performance eye, one verdict, every week on Spotify, YouTube, and Apple Podcasts. Got a nagging ache or a training plateau? Send us your video question — we might use it on the show

title: The Reconciliation Podcast
author: Bella K
description:
Bella K is a reconciliation, relationship and embodiment coach and host of The Reconciliation Podcast, exploring whether reconciliation is truly possible and how to navigate the moments when it feels like it's slipping away.
Having reconciled with her own ex-husband five years post-separation and three years post-divorce, Bella teaches a different path back - not tactics or a 10-step plan, but embodiment, nervous system regulation and becoming the person with whom reconciliation is possible.
Wherever you are, if you're in the thick of it, you're in the right place.

title: Born Between The Lines: Lucy’s Adoption Story
author: Queen Ethelburga’s Studios
description: What do you say to the parents you've never met? Lucy was adopted as a baby, and when she turned 18 she decided to find out. In Born Between the Lines, a five-part series made by two students in Queen Ethelburga's studio in York, she tells her own adoption story. She also sits down with other adopted people, parents and the professionals who bring families together, to talk honestly about identity, belonging and the comments nobody should have to hear. Each episode ends with a letter to her birth parents, and by the finale that letter has been answered.

The Open Chair is a conversation podcast with Mike & Sarah, where creators, founders, students, artists, researchers, athletes, and people with a story worth hearing take a seat to share their ideas and experiences. Each episode explores their story, their work, the choices they’ve made, and what they’ve learned along the way. No perfect answers—just thoughtful, personal conversations about what people are building, learning, and becoming.
One chair. A different person. A different story. Every episode.

author: RayBlanco5150
description:
Recovery gave me a way out...but it didn’t explain everything.
Recovery Didn’t Explain This takes an unflinching look at addiction, prison, loneliness, trauma, identity, and the parts of survival that conventional recovery conversations often leave untouched. This isn’t another collection of slogans or simple answers. It’s an honest investigation into why people use, what drugs may have been doing for them, and what remains after the drugs are gone.
For anyone who got clean and discovered that addiction wasn’t even half the problem...and anyone willing to see recovery from a different angle.

author: Coach Tom
description:
For the husband trying to save his marriage while his wife is already halfway out the door.
If she's gone cold, asked for space, or started talking about divorce, the instinct is to chase, plead, and fix everything at once, and that usually makes it worse. Each episode, Tom gets straight to it: what's really going on in her head, what you're doing that's pushing her away, and the calm, grounded moves that give your marriage a real chance.
Part of Marriage Reset. New episodes every Friday.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare: Free Courses from the institute

description:
A free and open online publication of educational material from thousands of MIT courses, covering the entire MIT curriculum, ranging from introductory to the most advanced graduate courses. On the OCW website, each course includes a syllabus, instructional material like notes and reading lists, and learning activities like assignments and solutions. Some courses also have videos, online textbooks, and faculty insights on teaching.

Knowledge is your reward. There's no signup or enrollment, and no start or end dates. OCW is self-paced learning at its best.

Whether you’re a student, a teacher, or simply a curious person that wants to learn, MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) offers a wealth of insight, inspiration, videos, and a whole lot more!

title: FrenchTober : October French Writing Challenge
author: Better French Speaking with Laetitia Perraut
description:
Every day in October, one short prompt to get you writing in French.
You understand French, but when it’s time to speak, the words don’t come together? Writing is the answer. Building good sentences on paper is how you learn to build them out loud: better writing leads to better speaking.
Inspired by Inktober, FrenchTober is a 31-day challenge for learners from A2 to C1. Each episode lasts no more than a minute and a half: listen to the day’s prompt, then write. This year’s theme is cooking. We start gently, with a single sentence a day in the first week, then build up step by step until you’re writing a full text in the final week.
Hosted by Laetitia, who has been creating One Thing In A French Day for 20 years.
Starts on 1 October. More at www.onethinginafrenchday.com

Whether we're breaking down the latest aesthetic treatment, answering the questions you're too nervous to ask at your appointment, talking about running and growing a medspa, or just catching up on life, relationships, culture, and the chaos in between—you're getting the real conversation.
Expect expert education without the intimidating medical jargon, honest conversations about beauty and confidence, behind-the-scenes business talk, plenty of laughs, and two women who definitely aren't afraid to tell it like it is.
Because glowing isn't just about what you see in the mirror. It's about feeling confident, building the life you want, and learning to just glow with it.
New episodes of Just Glow With It bring you conversations about aesthetics, skincare, medspa treatments, beauty, wellness, female entrepreneurship, Latina business owners, confidence, and real life.

Global events, market swings, massive tech shifts, the news moves fast, and it all hits your wallet. But keeping track of it doesn't have to be a full-time job.

What happens when the usual way forward stops working?
In Doing It Differently, Nasya Munga sits down with people whose lives forced them to question the rules, beliefs or identities they had once accepted.
From addiction and survival to money, work, family, scams and recovery, each episode begins with a remarkable personal story and opens into a bigger question: why do we keep doing things that no longer work, and what does it take to choose another path?

title: Juicy Scoop with Heather McDonald
author: Maria
description: When Heather isn't headlining theaters across the country as a top stand-up comedian or being the perfect wife and mother of three, she is diving into juicy pop culture. From all things Hollywood, celebrity romances, Bravo TV to her real-life drama, Heather tackles the juiciest and most controversial topics. She will not hold back on her opinion on anything or anyone. While talking to guests ranging anywhere from actors to comics to reality stars, Heather asks the juiciest questions you always want to be answered.  For advertising opportunities please email:  PodcastPartnerships@Studio71us.com     We want to make the podcast even better, help us learn how we can:  https://bit.ly/2EcYbu4    Privacy Policy:  https://www.studio71.com/terms-and-conditions-use/#Privacy%20Policy

title: Beyond Arthur
author: Dr Manon Metzger
description:
The Legends You Know - The Insights You Don’t
Beyond Arthur is a podcast that brings together legend and academia, to tell the enduring stories of the Round Table and speak with the scholars who know them best.

title: Storying Water
author: Ellen Wiles
description: This podcast takes you on a journey along a river from source to sea over ten episodes, exploring how the water system actually works, what's involved in getting drinkable water to our taps, risks to its resilience in a fast-changing climate, and solutions that involve working with nature. Written and narrated by author Ellen Wiles, Artist-in-Residence at an environmental science centre, it features a kaleidoscope of expert interviews with people ranging from farmers and fishermen to campaigners, executives, regulators and scientists.

title: Joes F1 Rundown
author: Joe Cliffe
description:
Welcome to Joe’s F1 Rundown — an F1 podcast from a fan’s point of view.
After each Grand Prix, I’ll work my way through the field from the back all the way up to P1, talking about how I thought each driver’s race went, what went right, what went wrong and the big moments along the way.
I’ll also cover some of the latest Formula 1 news and anything else from the world of F1 that catches my attention.
I’m not a journalist or an F1 expert — just a fan, a microphone and plenty of opinions about Formula 1.

title: Three Objects
author: Victoria and Albert Museum
description: Welcome to Three Objects, a brand-new podcast miniseries that delves deep into V&A museum collections. Join host Zakia Sewell as she revisits seminal moments in British music history, connecting the people who made them happen to objects with a story to tell.

title: SlowBurn
author: Hypothetically Speaking
description:
SlowBurn is an honest and curious look at sex, dating, relationships, kink and the things we rarely say out loud.
Created mainly for men, each episode offers just one woman’s perspective on attraction, desire, fantasies and connection. It may be sweet, cheeky, occasionally flirty, direct or unexpectedly blunt, but it will always be honest.
No judgement, no pretending, just the conversations we probably should be having.
Have a question or topic you’d like discussed? Send it through privately.
But that’s all hypothetical, isn’t it.

title: The Road Ahead with The AA
author: The AA
description:
The Road Ahead with The AA is a new monthly podcast exploring the big issues affecting drivers and the future of motoring.
Hosted by Jack Cousens, AA Head of Roads Policy, each episode brings together experts and industry voices for an in-depth conversation about the topics that matter to drivers, from road safety and the cost of motoring to electric vehicles, potholes and the changing way we travel.
Drawing on The AA’s expertise, insight and experience representing millions of drivers, The Road Ahead goes beyond the headlines to explore what’s changing, why it matters and what it means for people on the road.
Got a question or an idea for a future episode? Email theroadahead@theaa.com

title: Greeking Out from National Geographic Kids
author: nhyu
description: Oh, Muses! Hear our podcast and allow us to recall some of the greatest stories ever told. Stories of gods and goddesses, monsters, and heroes! Enjoy this kid-friendly retelling of classic ancient Greek myths for the whole family.  ----  Parents, the Greeking Out books are out! Three of them! Available wherever you get your books.    ⚡ Want more? Binge the full show, including new episodes, ad-free at pinna.fm. Use code GREEKINGOUT30 to receive a special discount!

title: Achieving More Together
author: Mills & Reeve
description: Achieving More Together is Mills & Reeve's high-performance podcast. Hosted by Juliet Mann, the series explores what it really takes to build, lead and sustain high-performing teams in today's complex world. Through conversations with leaders, practitioners and performers from business, sport, technology, public service and beyond, each episode uncovers practical lessons on leadership, culture, resilience and collaboration.

title: Founders and Funders, with Susannah Streeter
author: Wealth Club
description:
The Founders and Funders podcast, with Susannah Streeter of Wealth Club, brings together founders, investors and industry experts to examine what it takes to build and scale ambitious businesses in the UK.
The podcast covers venture capital, private equity, innovation, emerging sectors and the people, businesses and ideas shaping investment. Whether you're a founder, investor or simply interested in UK business, Founders & Funders offers an informed perspective on the opportunities ahead.
Read more and subscribe: https://www.wealthclub.co.uk/podcast

title: Accounting On It
author: ICAS
description:
Think accountants just tell you what already happened? Wrong way round.

They are the people decision-makers turn to when they want to understand what to do next. That puts accountants in Formula 1 paddocks, on film sets and inside fraud investigations.

Accounting on It picks a world each episode and finds out how the money in it really works. Host Emily Willis, a Chartered Accountant and Senior Finance Manager at Wordsmith AI, gets one surprising money-fact worth repeating, three counterintuitive truths most people would be surprised to hear, and learns why the accountant is the one unlocking what no one else in the room can.

Every episode closes on a quickfire round, with some of the questions sent in by listeners as voice notes.

Sport. Film and television. Fraud. Fashion. Festivals. Tax, audit and forensics. Worlds you are curious about and the surprising truths you can take to the pub.

If you're 16 to 24 and still working out what to do with your life, and accounting has never once made the shortlist, give us twenty minutes.

New episodes every other Wednesday.


 Accounting on It is powered by ICAS, the world's first professional body of Chartered Accountants

title: NSFW Jokes
author: Johnson Hazard
description:
VERY NSFW and non-PC with a splashing of dark humor. Not for children.

NSFW jokes collated from reddit.com/r/dadjokes, /r/unclejokes, r/3amjokes and r/Jokes.

Credits are found on the show notes page of each episode.

title: Dr. Montessori's Own Handbook (Methods for Early Childhood Education)
author: Maria Montessori
description:
Maria Montessori unveils her groundbreaking approach to early childhood education in "Dr. Montessori's Own Handbook." This audiobook serves as both a manual and a manifesto, offering a clear and concise overview of the Montessori Method specifically designed for children ages three to six. Montessori dives straight into the heart of her philosophy, emphasizing the child as an active participant in their own learning journey. Through practical insights, she outlines essential materials and activities that foster independence, curiosity, and a love for learning.

Listeners will discover the central conflict between traditional education methods and Montessori's innovative practices. How do we nurture a child’s natural instincts while guiding their development? Montessori addresses this question head-on, providing compelling reasons for her techniques and the profound impact they can have on a child’s growth. This audiobook invites parents, caregivers, and educators to rethink their approach to teaching and embrace a method that respects the unique individuality of each child.

With practical applications and vivid examples, Montessori's insights resonate with anyone eager to understand the dynamics of early education. Whether you’re a seasoned educator or a parent seeking to enrich your child’s learning experience, this audiobook will spark your curiosity and inspire meaningful discussions about the future of education. Don’t miss the chance to learn from one of the pioneers of child-focused education.

title: Hot Trivia Time Machine
author: Quiz Meisters
description:
Welcome to Hot Trivia Time Machine! We're stranded in a random week from the past two decades, and asking the locals what year it is might destroy the space-time continuum. The safest option? Play the local pub quiz to figure out where we are in time.
Hosted by Captain Crispy and created by Quiz Meisters. Test your knowledge against ours and use the trivia clues to guess the exact year and month we've landed in before the episode ends. Lets goooooo!!!!!1!!

title: The Bitchtorical Record
author: Julia Messer
description:
A comedy podcast where Head Bitchtorian, Julia Messer, educates prospective Bitchtorians on a range of historical topics. Can her guests pass the Entrance Exam? Doubtful. But there is always extra credit.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Śrīmad Devī Bhāgavatam | Śakti Vāṇī
author: Śakti Vāṇī
description:
Enter the extraordinary world of the Śrīmad Devī Bhāgavatam.
Journey through the Śrīmad Devī Bhāgavatam, one Adhyāya at a time, with English audio overviews exploring the Divine Mother’s līlās, teachings, and the wisdom held within each chapter.
Following the Śrīmad Devī Bhāgavatam Skandha by Skandha and Adhyāya by Adhyāya, each episode brings together the heart of a chapter in an accessible listening format, as a companion to discovering and studying the text.
Jai Mā 🌺

title: Best Case with Amanda Case
author: Amanda Case
description:
The Best Case with Amanda Case is your go-to real estate podcast for home buyers and sellers navigating the process with confidence. Each episode breaks down the real estate contracts, home inspection process, mortgage financing, and legal steps involved in buying or selling a house — no jargon, no guesswork.

Whether you're a first time home buyer trying to understand pre-approval and closing costs, or a seller preparing your property for appraisal and title transfer, Amanda Case brings clear, practical real estate advice to help you make your best case — literally and figuratively — at every stage of homeownership.

New episodes cover topics like:

What to expect during a home inspection
How mortgage financing and pre-approval actually work
Understanding real estate contracts and closing documents
Title insurance, appraisals, and what can delay a sale
Tips for first time home buyers and seasoned sellers alike

If you're buying a house, selling a house, or just want to understand the real estate process better, subscribe to The Best Case with Amanda Case for expert insight, real talk, and zero fluff.

title: Takeoffs Podcast™
author: The Flying Realtor (Juan Concheiro)
description:
Hosted by commercial pilot, real estate professional, and creator Juan Concheiro, Takeoffs is the podcast where the best conversations happen above the clouds.
Recorded in flight aboard a Cessna 182, each episode features candid conversations with entrepreneurs, business leaders, athletes, media personalities, aviators, and creators who are making an impact in their industries. From inspiring success stories and leadership lessons to behind-the-scenes moments and plenty of laughs, every flight offers a fresh perspective you won't find anywhere else.

title: More Dog Talk
author: Bella and Mark
description: Because you were going to talk about your dog anyway. More Dog Talk is the friendly, slightly obsessive podcast for people who love their dogs a little too much. Each episode digs into training struggles, health myths, breed debates, and the wonderfully weird things our dogs do, with help from trainers, vets, and fellow dog people. Plus listener stories, Dog of the Week, and the week's most wholesome dog news. Sit. Stay. Listen.

title: Soggy Bottoms
author: Madeline Bhaskar
description:
This murder mystery comedy takes British whodunnit’s and The Great British Bake Off and mixes them together into one delicious treat for your ears.
Our story begins when an elderly woman is found dead on a popular baking competition show. Most assume that it’s an unfortunate accident; however, Detective and baking enthusiast Edie Pillai believes that there’s a soggy bottom underneath it all.
Starring Katherine Rogers, Michael MacLeod, Sydnée Grant, and Cory Coogan. Written and directed by Madeline Bhaskar. Edited by Alexander Gonzalez. Cover art by Gabbi Soong.

title: Amacad
author: American Academy of Arts and Sciences
description:
The American Academy of Arts and Sciences since 1780 has recognized and convened leaders across disciplines and divides. Together, these individuals examine new ideas, address major issues, and advance the common good.
On Amacad, Academy President Laurie Patton speaks with Academy members about their lives and work, diving deep into the experiences that shape their approaches and perspectives.

title: The Notes Session
author: The Notes Session
description:
We love opera. We have some notes. Welcome to The Notes Session.
We are two American opera singers who trained in the US, built careers in Europe, and have spent years swapping voice notes about the art form. Now we're doing it with microphones.
What can you expect? Mainly something we're calling "consensus punditry," along with live-show reports, long-form researched video essays, guest conversations, close listening to great singing, and discussions about the industry's sticky questions.
New episodes (most) Thursdays. We're glad you're here.

title: Isometric View
author: Loft Design
description:
We live in a world shaped by Design, but the people, decisions, and systems behind it are often invisible.In each episode, we take a closer look at how design actually happens - from the first spark of an idea to the realities of engineering, manufacturing, human factors, branding, and business. 
We explore the challenges of designing for high-stakes environments, the evolution of creative workflows, and the constant tension between ambition, impact, and commercial reality. 
An original brought to you by Loft Design.

title: Winning Mindset Mastery
author: April Shprintz
description:
Talent, education, skill, and motivation are universally attainable. Yet, no matter how you work, you will never be able to accomplish your goals or reach your full potential unless you have one essential ingredient. A growth mindset is the defining characteristic of how you experience life. By changing your frame of mind, you can improve your behaviors, discard negative thoughts, and become a more empowered person.

That’s exactly what you'll learn from the Winning Mastery Mindset podcast. In each episode, you'll receive expert advice on how to break free from the mundane routine of daily life and understand you were created to accomplish great things. If you've achieved your goals, reached the top, and feel like there's still something missing in your life, this is your show.

Join sales expert, award winning author and business accelerator April Shprintz for inspiring and thought-provoking lessons that will equip you with the winning mindset you need to succeed. She has the power to alter your outlook so that you can surpass even your wildest expectations.

April brings to the show her contagious energy, passion, and expertise in helping people from all walks of life master their mindset and master their life by getting on the path to massive success. You’ll never experience lasting success if you constantly struggle with your mindset, and she shows you why. Discover how to create a growth mindset that is completely aligned with your own definition of success using April's simple and easy to apply how-to strategies. Her advice on developing your mindset can improve your perspective on life as a whole and the role you play in it.

In just a few minutes per episode, you'll be immersed in April’s incredible wisdom, often learned by making the same mistakes you have, which will help you overcome feelings of fear, achieving your full potential, and moving past any doubts about your abilities. April reveals effective methods for creating more productive habits, increasing wealth, improving personal relationships, and achieving genuine happiness.

April also gets vulnerable, sharing her own story and the important life lessons she's learned along her incredible journey. Having started her first business at the tender age of six, this remarkable woman has a deep understanding of the power of a winning mindset and how to capitalize on opportunities create a path for yourself when there doesn’t seem to be one. 

As a certified hypnotist and NLP practitioner, April brings a wealth of expertise to the show about the neuroscience behind our habits and our mindset. She helps others access their inner resources and make a strong connection with their unconscious mind by explaining the brain's inner workings. And every so often, April will enter a segment she dubs "Woo Woo." Using the principles of the Law of Attraction, she explains how you can use your mind and emotions to manifest things you once thought impossible.

Because of April's knowledge and first-hand experience in the field of neuroscience, she is the ideal guide. As long as you're willing to put in the work, she’s happy to show you how to bring yourself into a life you’ve only imagined.. Mindset is the foundation of everything you’ve ever wanted. It dictates how we experience the world, and who we are as human beings. Above all, it helps you plot the roadmap for the life you really want to create.

title: Test Corrections with Josh Andrew
author: Liberty Classical Schools
description: Life presents us with tests along the way. This podcast is an opportunity to revisit past mistakes and misses in hopes of making "test corrections" as we navigate life, leadership, education and more.

title: Hey You, Indulge My Delusions
author: Tell
description:
"Hey you... yes, you. Would you indulge my delusions for a second?"
Welcome to the show where we take the most ridiculous, unhinged, and bizarre shower thoughts, and analyze them with deadly serious science, physics, and fluid dynamics.
Sit back, grab your headphones, and let our AI hosts dive way too deep into questions nobody asked, but everyone secretly wants the answer to.
*Note: This podcast uses AI voices to explore absurd thought experiments and hypothetical science.

title: Beyond The Group: Unfiltered
author: Olivia Dixon
description:
Beyond the Group: Unfiltered brings real East Tennessee stories to the mic. 🎙️
We're talking family, parenting, recovery, starting over, mental health, loss, relationships, healthcare, community, and the struggles people often face behind closed doors.
Hear from everyday people, local businesses, healthcare workers, community organizations, caregivers, and others with stories worth sharing.
No perfect lives. No pretending. No judgment.
Real people. Real stories. Real East Tennessee. 💚

title: Early Adopters: CISO
author: Front Lines Studios
description: How does the modern CISO decide what to trust? Hosted by Dan Nguyen-Huu, partner at Decibel, Early Adopters: CISO talks to security leaders about how they evaluate new technology, build trust with vendors, manage risk, and decide what is worth bringing into their companies. Across the six-part series, Dan speaks with CISOs from companies including 1Password, Plaid, Legora, and others about the bets that paid off, the ones they missed, and how AI is changing the way security teams make decisions.

title: I’m Not a Politician, But…
author: Nate BossDon
description: Politics affects your money, your rights, your job, your neighborhood, and your future, so why does everybody explain it like regular people can’t understand it? I break down politics, elections, government, money, power, and current events in real everyday language. No party worship. No talking down to people. No telling you who to vote for. Just receipts, real context, and the questions regular people should be asking. We don’t protect politicians over here. But we don’t lie on them either.

title: The Community Podcast: The Upper East Side
author: Chris Murray
description:
Welcome to The Upper East Side, part of The Community Podcast, where we put the spotlight on the people, places, and stories shaping Central Iowa's northeast communities. Covering Ankeny, Altoona, Bondurant, Pleasant Hill, and surrounding communities, it's your connection to what's happening across this growing part of Central Iowa.
Hosted by Chris Murray, The Upper East Side features conversations with local leaders, business owners, organizations, and community members who know these communities best. Each episode takes you behind the businesses, projects, initiatives, and ideas making an impact throughout the area.
From new developments and local businesses to community events, organizations, and people doing great things, The Upper East Side brings local stories to the forefront. It's a place to stay informed, discover what's new, and get to know more about the communities around you.
Tune in to The Upper East Side and discover more of the community around you. Every conversation is an opportunity to share local stories, strengthen connections, and bring people together as we continue building stronger communities across Central Iowa.

title: Making sense of global challenges
author: Bergen Global
description: A podcast featuring recordings of conversations and lectures organised by Bergen Global at the University of Bergen and Chr. Michelsen Institute.

title: HN Digest
author: Xun
description: The best of Hacker News, read aloud: what each story says and what the comment thread made of it.

title: Sister Friend
author: Cecily Breaux, Adeline Minton
description: Two sisters, who are also friends, learn and laugh each episode as they ask each other life's pressing questions - and likely not get answers.

title: CGMA Success Stories
author: AICPA & CIMA
description: This show was produced by our presenters from AICPA & CIMA offices across the world for conversations about inspiration, knowledge, and success in CGMA!

title: I'm A sickO
author: Jay El
description:
Obsessions. Confessions. The thoughts we’re not supposed to say out loud.


I’m a SickO is a raw, non-fictional journey into the darker corners of attraction, obsession, curiosity, and human behavior. It’s sensual, uncomfortable, sometimes funny, and unapologetically honest—exploring the thoughts we hide behind polite smiles and innocent conversations.


Because sometimes the most fucked-up thoughts aren’t the ones we act on.


They’re the ones we secretly relate to.


No fantasy. No filters. Just the confessions we’re usually too embarrassed to admit.

title: Grief Action Thought Drops
author: Dr Lisa Burke
description:
Hosted by internationally recognised Clinical Psychologist and Fellow in Thanatology, Dr Lisa Burke, Grief Action Thought Drops offers 60-second insights into grief, loss, and human connection. Each episode is designed for professionals who value a deeper understanding of grief and bereavement.
This micro-podcast offers grief literacy without clichés. It’s about practical insight, not platitudes.
New episodes every Tuesday and Thursday.
Learn more at https://www.griefaction.com
This podcast is for educational purposes only and does not constitute psychological advice or therapy.

title: Healing At The Cookout
author: Audori Scott
description:
Healing at the Cookout is a gathering that blends the warmth of a traditional backyard barbecue with the transformative power of community wellness. It is a intentional space where people can share good food, lean into deep conversations, and find emotional release and collective restoration among friends and chosen family.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Soma Tea with Lee
author: Lee Fogel
description: Inspiring intuitive, embodied living for a better world.

title: The L Project
author: Jean Lambert
description:
The L Project is a business podcast where guests will share the stories and experiences they gathered throughout their successful lives. We will be exploring their lives beyond their businesses to see how to be a successful entrepreneur "in life".
www.theLproject.eu
Instagram: thelproject_
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/thelproject-eu

title: "Canvas Confidential"
author: Madison
description: Each episode will discuss a famous artwork with a history, mystery, crime, or complicated story behind it/hidden within the piece itself.

title: Stress Tested
author: news.com.au
description: What is the true cost of success? news.com.au Finance Editor Ben Graham and Senior Reporter Harrison Christian sit down with Australia’s most influential leaders, industry giants, and innovators to dissect their massive wins, and their critical failures. Get the ultimate insider's look at the minds shaping Australia’s future.

title: Big Fun with the Wretched
author: Nikiyah Sutton-Edwards & Genéa Bullock
description:
Welcome to Big Fun with the Wretched — where the group chat meets the microphone. 🎙️

Hosted by Bronx & Shaolin, this is the podcast for unfiltered conversations about relationships, dating, friendships, girl code, family, celebrity drama, pop culture, and the everyday situations that have everybody choosing sides.

Nothing is too messy, too controversial, or too uncomfortable to talk about. From “high-value” dating and relationship double standards to mean-girl culture, sisterhood, celebrity scandals, and the conversations everybody is having behind closed doors — Bronx & Shaolin are bringing it straight to the mic.

Expect laughs, disagreements, unpopular opinions, real-life perspectives, and plenty of “WAIT… WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?!” moments.

We might not always agree — and you probably won’t agree with us either. That’s the fun part.

🎙️ Big Fun with the Wretched
Celebrity Tea. Relationships. Real Life. Unfiltered.

Pull up a seat. The group chat is officially in session.tnn yu

title: The Candy Corn Club
author: Lauren
description: Grab a drink, hop into your PJs, and let’s chat Halloween! This cozy, casual podcast explores spooky books, movies, and shows, plus seasonal baking, and everyday Halloween lifestyle. Whether it’s October or the middle of summer, there’s always something spooky to talk about.

title: Layla & Nancy's Big Adventures
author: Josh
description:
Welcome to Layla & Nancy’s Big Adventures, a fun, family-friendly podcast inspired by two real-life bulldog sisters living in Los Angeles! Layla is a thoughtful English Bulldog who likes to figure things out before jumping in, while her French Bulldog sister Nancy is curious, energetic, and always ready to explore.


Each episode takes Layla and Nancy on a new adventure filled with imagination, mystery, laughter, friendship, and a little learning along the way. From spooky fall adventures and unexpected discoveries to everyday moments that turn into something exciting, you never know where their curiosity will take them next.


Created for kids and families, Layla & Nancy’s Big Adventures brings the world of Layla and Nancy to life through storytelling, sound effects, and characters kids can grow to love. Their adventures also continue through coloring books, videos, printable activities, contests, and more at http://LaylaNancysBigAdventures.com.


Come along—there’s always another adventure waiting!

title: Tenancy Talks BC
author: 88West realty
description: Welcome to Tenancy Talks BC, brought to you by 88West Realty. Join us as we dive into real BC tenancy laws, property management insights, and authentic rental stories to help landlords and tenants navigate the British Columbia real estate market with confidence

title: Talkin' MetLife
author: CougarTV
description: Joe and Ivan discuss all thing Jets and Giants....and more!

title: Isolatiebedrijf Heerenveen
author: Sem Huisman
description: Welkom bij het podcastkanaal van Isolatiebedrijf Heerenveen, dé plek voor praktische informatie, deskundige tips en interessante gesprekken over woningisolatie, energiebesparing en duurzaam wonen. Vanuit onze ervaring met onder andere dakisolatie, vloerisolatie en spouwmuurisolatie delen we waardevolle kennis voor huiseigenaren en bedrijven die hun pand comfortabeler en energiezuiniger willen maken.In onze afleveringen bespreken we verschillende isolatiematerialen, moderne isolatietechnieken en slimme oplossingen om warmteverlies te beperken. Ook behandelen we onderwerpen zoals het kiezen van de juiste isolatiemethode, het verbeteren van het binnenklimaat en belangrijke aandachtspunten bij renovatie- en verduurzamingsprojecten.Isolatiebedrijf Heerenveen wil complexe isolatieonderwerpen begrijpelijk maken, zodat luisteraars beter geïnformeerde keuzes kunnen maken voor hun woning of bedrijfspand. Of je nu meer wilt weten over vloerisolatie, dakisolatie, spouwmuurisolatie of algemene energiebesparende maatregelen: onze podcast biedt heldere en bruikbare informatie.Luister mee, ontdek nieuwe mogelijkheden en vergroot je kennis over professioneel isoleren.Meer informatie over onze diensten vind je op https://isolatiebedrijfheerenveen.com.

title: Off the Page
author: Zander
description: Off the Page is a kids' show hosted by 11-year-old Zander. Books, stories, and everything in between: Harry Potter deep-dives, original fiction, jiu-jitsu, football stats, and a listener writing challenge in every episode.

title: The Toy Box
author: The Educated Toy Box
description: The Toy Box, where play meets purpose. A daily 3-minute show for parents who want less screen time and more real play. Each episode gives you one simple, screen-free play idea to try today; no elaborate crafts, no expensive gear. Brought to you by The Educated Toy Box (educatedtoybox.com), the educational toy store where every toy earns its place

title: Fathers for Faith & Freedom Bible Study
author: Fathers For Faith & Freedom
description:
Weekly Bible study from Fathers for Faith & Freedom. We open Scripture together, talk as men, and apply the Word to marriage, fatherhood, the church, and the public square.
This is the recorded archive of our live X Space study. Come for the passage. Stay for brothers who will not apologize for the gospel.
We believe Jesus Christ is the way, the truth, and the life; that marriage is one man and one woman; that God made two sexes, male and female; that life begins at conception and must be protected; and that the U.S. Constitution is the charter of the freedoms we intend to keep.

title: Run Intel | The Marketing of Running
author: Josh Rosenthal
description:
Run Intel is a weekly podcast and intelligence brief about running marketing.  Each week, Borderlands breaks down the marketing campaigns that worked, the expensive misses, major partnerships, launches, media moves, and emerging signals shaping the running industry. Built for marketers, brand leaders, founders, agencies, retailers, media teams, and anyone working in the business of running.
We look at running brands, sports marketing, footwear marketing, trail running, road running, sponsorships, partnerships, athlete marketing, creator marketing, product launches, retail, paid media, brand campaigns, running industry trends, and the business of running.

title: The Overflow Collective Podcast
author: Vids Inc. TV
description:
Something NEW is overflowing! We’re excited to introduce The Overflow Collective, a LIVE weekly morning show where three entrepreneurs come together to talk about the journey while we’re actually living it.Business. Faith. Money. Relationships. Purpose. Wins. Challenges. Growth. And the real conversations that happen behind the scenes while you're building the life you envision.We’re not showing up pretending to have everything figured out. We’re building, believing, growing, supporting each other—and choosing to live in overflow along the way.This is more than a podcast. It’s a journey in real time, and you’re invited to grow with us.
🎙️ THE OVERFLOW COLLECTIVE
🔴 FIRST SHOW — LIVE!
⏰ 7:30 AM
Come start your morning with us.We’re not waiting to arrive to start living in overflow.#TheOverflowCollective #LiveInOverflow #Entrepreneurship #Purpose #Faith #Abundance #Business #MorningShow #Podcast

title: Sunshine Coast: Campaign Voices
author: Coast Reporter
description: It's 2026 and it's time for local elections across British Columbia. Here on the Sunshine Coast, the Coast Reporter newspaper has joined the Sunshine Coast Chamber of Commerce to present in-depth conversations with candidates for the Town of Gibsons, the District of Sechelt, and the Sunshine Coast Regional District. Editor Bronwyn Beairsto hosts each interview, focusing on a range of topics relevant to the Coast's diverse population.

title: Backstage At the Spire
author: The Spire Center for the Performing Arts
description:
The stories, personalities, and conversations behind the performances.
Backstage At The Spire takes listeners beyond the curtain and into the fascinating world of the Spire Center for Performing Arts. Hosted by Dona Maher, Board Member, Executive Producer of Sunday Serenades, and Director of the Spire Music Academy, alongside six-time Emmy Award–winning pianist and composer Lenny Williams, Professor in the Film Scoring Department at Berklee College of Music and Distinguished Faculty at Spire Music Academy, the podcast offers an intimate, entertaining, and revealing look at the people who make the Spire come alive.

From classical music to jazz, rock, Broadway, comedy, film scoring, lectures, and everything in between, every episode reveals another side of the remarkable creative community that makes the Spire unique.
Come backstage. Meet the people. Hear the stories. Discover what happens when the lights go down and the real conversations begin.
Backstage At The Spire — where the stories behind the stage take center stage.

title: Football Fantasy House The Podcast
author: Football Fantasy House
description:
# FOOTBALL FANTASY HOUSE
### Where Football Fantasy Becomes Reality.
What happens when fantasy football leaves the app… and enters the HOUSE?
Welcome to **Football Fantasy House (FFH)** — a fantasy football entertainment experience built around competition, personalities, NFL conversation, bold predictions, bragging rights, and the one thing every fantasy league has plenty of: **TRASH TALK.**
Created by **E.L. Williams**, Football Fantasy House is building something bigger than another fantasy football podcast. The long-term vision is an original reality competition where fantasy football players live, compete, strategize, and battle their way through an NFL season under one roof — bringing the drama, rivalries, alliances, victories, bad decisions, and personalities of fantasy football to life.
But before we build the House, we’re building the **community**.
The Football Fantasy House Podcast is where that journey begins.
Each week, FFH brings together a cast of football personalities with different perspectives, strategies, and opinions. You’ll hear fantasy football analysis, NFL debates, waiver-wire conversations, injury updates, start-or-sit decisions, sportsbook talk, weekly predictions — and plenty of receipts when somebody gets it completely wrong.
Leading the House is **Bobby Hall — ”The Prez”**, President of Football Fantasy House and Host, keeping the conversation moving while trying to maintain order inside a House full of opinions.
Behind the fantasy competition is ** — ”The Mish,”** the Commissioner of Football Fantasy House. With decades of fantasy football experience, The Mish oversees the league, matchups, challenges, rules and weekly business of the House.
Then there’s **The L.A.B. — Lines. Analytics. Bets.** Featuring **Shawn ”Moneyline” Peterson and Doug**, The L.A.B. breaks down the numbers, matchups, trends and betting angles behind the games.
You’ll also hear from **Big Alex**, whose strong opinions guarantee there won’t be many quiet debates, along with **E.L. Williams**, creator and executive producer of Football Fantasy House, and other members of the FFH league and special guests who enter the House throughout the season.
And underneath the microphones is a real fantasy league.
The personalities you hear aren’t simply talking about fantasy football — **they’re competing against each other.** Wins, losses, waiver decisions, trades, predictions and weekly bragging rights have consequences, giving everyone inside the House something to prove.
Expect signature FFH conversations and segments including **Park ’Em or Drive ’Em, House-spital, Waiver Wire, Panic or Patience, House Calls, The L.A.B., Who You Got**, weekly House awards, bold predictions and much more.
Football Fantasy House is where **fantasy football, sports entertainment, competition and reality collide.**
Today, it’s a podcast.
Tomorrow, the vision is much bigger.
We’re building the audience. We’re building the personalities. We’re building the rivalries. We’re building the community.
And eventually…
**we’re putting them in the House.**
Whether you’re a fantasy football veteran, a casual NFL fan, a sportsbook player, or somebody who simply loves great sports debates and entertaining personalities, there’s a seat for you inside Football Fantasy House.
**Welcome to the House.**
**FOOTBALL FANTASY HOUSE**
*Where Football Fantasy Becomes Reality.*

The Catechism is an adult confirmation podcast designed for ELCA Lutheran Adults who want a confirmation refresher course, never went through confirmation, or joined an ELCA congregation from another tradition and want to learn more about what it means to be ELCA Lutheran. The basics of the Christian faith are covered including how to read the bible, prayer, the Apostle's Creed, and living our faith in the world.
The podcast is designed and led by Pastor Jeremy Morelock and Brian Hehn

title: DigitalDownlow
author: Crystal Chambers
description:
DigitalDownlow is what happens when curiosity refuses to stay in its lane.
Hosted by CiCi Chambers, she takes an unapologetically curious look at culture, trends, GenX (and the lesser ones, too), politics, technology, AI, relationships, media, philosophy, and the strange ways people make sense of the world. Sometimes serious, sometimes irreverent, occasionally profane—and always willing to ask the question everyone else seems to be stepping around.  
No prescribed conclusions. Just good questions, evidence, conversation, and the occasional "FFS! GTFOHWTBS." Conversations, culture, motorcycles, technology, life and whatever deserves a closer look.

title: The Military Chaplain Podcast for Veteran Mental Health, Hope & Healing | Tactical Wisdom, biblical hope, and honest conversations for veterans, military families, chaplains, and ministers.
author: Chaplain Dr. E. Ibanga Matthews |
description:
Beloved,
The military chaplain podcast delivers raw, honest, faith-rooted conversations about the things military and veteran communities are afraid to say out loud, the biblical truth that gives them the courage to say it anyway, and the hope that holds everything together when life tries to tear it apart.
Hosted by Chaplain Dr. E. Ibanga Matthews, a retired United States Army Chaplain, Lieutenant Colonel, with over 30 years of pastoral/chaplain military ministry.  This channel draws from real frontline experience to address the most urgent needs in veteran mental health, military family mental health, PTSD, and faith-based healing for those who serve and those who love them.
Chaplain Ibanga brings a rare combination to the veteran podcast space: the clinical awareness of a trained chaplain, the military credibility of a career officer who served in three combat deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan, the personal vulnerability of a man who has been honest about his own struggles, and the theological depth of a minister who believes that Scripture speaks directly into every human crisis — including the ones that happen in uniform.
Enjoy!
militarychaplainpodcast.com

title: Moo Cow Tales (Adventures from the Barnyard)
author: Rosamund Edith Nesbit Bland
description:
When young Tommy discovers his family’s barnyard cows can talk, he finds himself tangled in a whirlwind of hilarious adventures and whimsical mishaps. In 'Moo Cow Tales,' Rosamund Edith Nesbit Bland weaves four enchanting stories that bring to life the mischief and charm of barnyard life, inviting listeners into a world where cows have personalities as vibrant as their surroundings.

Join Tommy as he navigates the ups and downs of caring for his bovine friends, each tale bursting with laughter, friendship, and the occasional lesson learned. From a daring escape to a surprising talent show, these stories not only entertain but also spark the imagination of young listeners.

As Tommy learns the importance of teamwork and understanding, children will find themselves rooting for the cows and their comical escapades. With vivid characters and delightful scenarios, 'Moo Cow Tales' offers a joyful listening experience that fosters curiosity and creativity.

Perfect for family listening, these tales encourage discussions about friendship, responsibility, and the bonds we share with animals. Dive into this charming collection, where every moo tells a story, and let the laughter of the barnyard brighten your day. Get ready for a delightful journey that will leave both kids and parents smiling!

title: The Chaos Eliminator
author: Lana Sanderson
description:
In my corporate world, one of my mentors called me Chaos Coordinator and it kind of stuck. Then I realized coordinating the mess wasn't the goal — getting rid of it was.


On this show, I sit down with small business owners, contractors, and the people building things from the ground up to talk about what actually running a business looks like: the systems that save you, the fires you didn't see coming, and the moments you figure out how to eliminate the chaos instead of just managing it.


No polish, no pretending it's easy. Just real conversations about how businesses actually get built and kept running.

title: 980 the Sports Zone Local High School with John Balginy
author: John Balginy
description:
Local high school sports. Local voices. Every game matters.

Welcome to 980 The Sports Zone: Local High School Sports, your home for East Idaho high school sports coverage from 980 The Sports Zone.

Hear full game broadcasts, play-by-play action, and memorable moments from high school football, basketball, and more as we bring the games directly to you.

Whether you're in the stands, following your favorite team from home, or looking for a game you missed, this podcast gives local families, athletes, coaches, and fans another way to stay connected to high school sports across our community.

Listen to the game. Support the Sponsors. Support the Team. Follow local sports.

Presented by 980 The Sports Zone.

title: And The Movie Ends Podcast
author: tia t
description: a horror movie & tv podcast full of reviews discussions & way too much yapping about all things scary. grab your popcorn & let’s talk about what kept us up at night 🍿🔪

title: The MADD HOUSE
author: Lanisha Lewis
description: Welcome to The Madd House, a creative space where fashion, art, beauty, and imagination come together. This podcast explores creative ideas, fashion inspiration, digital marketing, branding, and the stories behind the things we create. Come along for conversations about creativity, trends, self-expression, and building a unique world of your own. There’s always a little bit of madness at The Madd House.

title: Kitchen Table AI Safety
author: Nate Nichols
description:
AI is changing your job, your kids' lives, and your country, and most of the big decisions are being made without you. Kitchen Table is AI safety for normal people: short, plain-English episodes about what AI actually is, where it's headed, and what you can do about it.

Host Nate Nichols has spent almost twenty years researching, building, and selling AI systems, and leads public AI workshops at Chicago libraries. Each week he takes one big question and gives you the straight answer in about ten minutes, no computer science degree required. Why can't the people who build AI explain how it works? Should you worry about your kids and AI chatbots? Who's writing the rules?

Every claim is sourced. The show notes link to the studies and data behind each episode, so you can check the work yourself.

New episodes every Tuesday.

Opinions are Nate's own and do not represent his employer.

title: Reviving the Curriculum
author: Dr Lisa Stephenson
description:
Reviving the Curriculum brings you into the centre of sustained research and practice, exploring how we can breathe new life into learning. Hosted by Dr Lisa Stephenson, each episode features deep-dive conversations with educators and leaders who are shifting the gaze from what we teach to how we teach.
We explore collaboration, agency, and creativity that promote collective wellbeing and understanding, responding to the complex world our students live in.
Produced by Story Makers, a research centre in the Carnegie School of Education at Leeds Beckett University.

title: Oops I Overthought
author: Good Mess Media
description:
What Are We Overthinking? Holly Fowler is a founder, podcast host and cultural voice redefining what modern leadership looks and sounds like.
As the founder of Wable App and a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, Holly builds with intention, creating platforms and conversations that make space for the nuanced, the ambitious, and the deeply human. Her work sits at the intersection of neurodivergent advocacy and next-generation leadership, proving that thinking differently isn't a limitation.
Holly doesn't just talk about building things differently. She just does it.

title: Terrorism Transforming
author: Scott Allan
description: Terrorism Transforming tracks the past, present, and future of terrorism. Hosted by Scott Allan, Senior Fellow in Terrorism Studies at The Jamestown Foundation, the podcast examines how violent extremism is evolving: the movements, tactics, technologies, and ideologies reshaping the threat landscape worldwide.

title: Your Mind, Your Body with Elena Monica
author: EverGreen Media Network
description: Join Elena Monica, PhD-C, on Your Mind, Your Body with Elena Monica as she explores the complexities of alcoholism, addiction, and the journey of recovery. Integrating a unique blend of spirituality and mind-body medicine, discover new perspectives on chronic illness, grief and bereavement, and other life challenges, opening pathways to healing, personal transformation, and a deeper connection with yourself and the world around you.

Step back into the American Old West with Gunsmoke, the legendary radio drama featuring Marshal Matt Dillon and the unforgettable characters of Dodge City.

Experience classic Western stories filled with mystery, adventure, justice, courage, and dramatic encounters from the golden age of radio. Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Gunsmoke for the first time, this podcast brings the timeless atmosphere of the Old West back to life.

Tune in and enjoy the classic adventures of Gunsmoke.

After Hours is a podcast hosted by Robert Mahon, built around honest conversations with the people who live, shape, and influence hospitality.

From longtime industry veterans and first-time restaurateurs to chefs, creatives, influencers, entrepreneurs, and the characters who make the industry what it is, each episode explores hospitality through a different point of view—the wins, the mistakes, the stories, and everything that happens behind the scenes.

description:
"Tres Cuentos" is a literary podcast exploring Latin American literature, oral traditions, folklore, history, and cultural heritage through carefully selected stories from across the region.
Originally produced between 2018 and 2022, the series features 58 episodes of historical narratives, fantasy, science fiction, poetry, and traditional tales. Now presented by "Casa Literaria", the home of Latin American stories, "Tres Cuentos" continues to celebrate the voices, imagination, and memory of Latin America.
Buen provecho—and happy listening!

title: Aviously
author: Avi Lev
description:
Aviously is about the work of becoming better—without pretending to have it all figured out.
Hosted by entrepreneur and CEO Avi Lev, Aviously explores the intersection of business, leadership, spirituality, recovery, relationships, and personal growth. Through honest conversations, interviews, and Torah bas reflections, Avi digs into what it means to build companies, build people, strengthen relationships, face your own struggles, and keep working on yourself along the way.
No polished answers. No pretending. Just real conversations about the things that actually matter—and the work it takes

From school events, and district initiatives, to classroom updates and practical parent tips - we’re here to keep you informed, connected, and supported throughout the school year.
Tune in to hear from guests across our school community, stay in the loop on upcoming events, and build a stronger community together.

description:
Out of the Basement is a podcast about the nerdy side of people you might not expect.

We sit down with musicians, artists, creators, industry professionals and interesting people from all walks of life and get them to reveal the obsessions they usually keep in the basement.

Warhammer. Dungeons & Dragons. Magic: The Gathering. Pokémon. Star Wars. Lord of the Rings. Gaming, comics, collecting and everything in between.

It’s about discovering what people geek out over, how those passions became part of who they are, and proving that everybody has a little nerd in them.

It’s time to come Out of the Basement.

title: Flayvor Sessions
author: Teree LeSueur
description: Flayvor Sessions is a podcast about understanding food beyond the recipe. Each episode explores how flavor, culture, memory, technique, and everyday experience shape the way we cook and eat. From ingredient behavior and cooking science to cravings, food identity, caregiving, and cultural foodways, Flayvor Sessions helps listeners become more curious, confident, and intentional in the kitchen.

title: So Today We...
author: Katie Ellis & Meagen Fowler
description:
So Today We… is two millennial moms navigating life after corporate America and figuring out what comes next—mostly as we go.


We’re talking motherhood, reinvention, current events, true crime, pop culture, questionable new adventures, and whatever random rabbit hole takes over our week.


Expect honest conversations, lots of laughs, strong opinions, occasional oversharing, and absolutely no pretending we have it all figured out.


We don’t have a niche. We barely have a plan.


So today we…talk about it.

description: The Clarksville Keys Podcast takes you inside the people, places, and stories that make Clarksville, Tennessee, home. Hosted by Travis Egan, VA Mortgage Vet, the show features conversations with local Realtors, business owners, and community leaders who know Clarksville and the Fort Campbell area firsthand. From real estate and PCSing to Fort Campbell to local businesses, restaurants, and hidden gems, each episode helps you Crack the Code to Clarksville Living!

title: CNY's Community Connection
author: Prevention Network
description:
For over 75 years, Prevention Network has served as a
trusted source for substance misuse prevention, education,
and support services in Central New York. What began as a
community-focused coalition has grown into a leading agency
delivering evidence-based programs that change lives,
empower families, and build healthier communities. Rooted
in public health we provide prevention strategies that are
proactive, inclusive, and grounded in research. Whether it’s
through youth empowerment, overdose prevention,
parenting support, or recovery resources, we are here to
strengthen every thread of the community fabric.

title: Redefined podcast
author: Ejiro John
description:
REDEFINED Podcast explores how we can rethink the beliefs, experiences, and expectations that shape the way we live.
Through honest conversations with people from different walks of life, we look at what it means to redefine success, relationships, career, personal growth, healing, and the stories we tell ourselves. Each episode offers a fresh perspective and practical insight to help you understand who you are, make intentional choices, and have a happier, more fulfilling life.
Because redefining your life begins with seeing it—and yourself—differently.

title: Wolves Collective

Welcome to Wolves Collective — a weekly Minnesota Timberwolves roundtable featuring Timberwolves analyst and host of The Dane Moore NBA Podcast Dane Moore, The Athletic senior writer Jon Krawczynski, and KFAN personality Justin Gaard. Moore has covered the Wolves extensively through his long-running NBA podcast, Krawczynski covers the Timberwolves and NBA for The Athletic, and Gaard is a longtime Minnesota sports radio voice on KFAN.

title: Savannah in Savannah
author: Savannah Young
description:
Yes, that's really my name. I have lived in Savannah long enough to know that the hostess city's best stories belong to the people who live here, not the tour guides. I spent twelve years interviewing strangers for a living. As it turns out, the people down the street had better stories.
Every episode is a conversation with a Savannahian, a neighbor: how they ended up in Savannah and what they know about the city that realtors will never tell you. Families, friends, and neighbors who've been on the same block for forty years but never really met.
Sponsor us: savannahespivey@gmail.com

title: Faith, Family & Real Estate
author: Tim & Myra Strecker
description:
We’re Tim and Myra Strecker. Welcome to Faith, Family & Real Estate.

We’ve been married 35 years, spent decades building a life in the Arkansas River Valley, raised a family, owned businesses, and now work together as real estate agents.

Along the way, we’ve learned that a house and a home aren’t always the same.

This channel is about more than buying and selling real estate. It’s about real people, real conversations, and life.

Faith is important to who we are. Family is at the center of our lives. Real estate is the business we’re blessed to build together.

We’ll sit down with pastors, leaders, families, friends, and people with stories worth hearing. Sometimes we’ll talk real estate. Sometimes faith. Sometimes family. And sometimes we may sit down with somebody and have a conversation about real experiences that shape who we become.

Our goal: Faith first. Family always. Helping people.

Subscribe, join the conversation, and come with us.

This is Faith, Family & Real Estate.

title: Let's Talk Fraud and Scams
author: Canadian Foundation for Economic Education
description:
Fraud can affect more than your finances. It can shake your confidence, your trust in others, and your sense of security.
Let’s Talk Fraud and Scams, from the Canadian Foundation for Economic Education (CFEE), brings together real stories and expert voices to explore how scams work, what happens when someone is targeted, and where people can turn for support.
Through conversations with people who have experienced fraud, lawyers, financial industry professionals, community organizers, mental health experts, and the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre, we look beyond the financial loss to understand th

title: All Roads Lead To Consent
author: Joycelyn Ghansah
description:
When you think of consent, do you only associate it with sexual or intimate settings, or do you consider it an everyday concept?

Join me as I discuss boundaries, language, and the importance of open communication in any relationship. Every episode, we step off the bus with the most experienced minds in consent research, from researchers, activists, clinicians, and educators to everyday individuals navigating the world with consent in mind.


We go beyond society’s ideas of consent. Opening with the question: ‘What is consent, and how does it look when we go beyond the bedroom?’

From sexual health to grief and burnout, consent is an everyday concept with an even deeper dialogue.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Life Between the lows
author: Life Between The Lows
description:
Life Between the Lows is a podcast hosted by us! Sarah & Sarah - two mums raising daughters with Type 1 diabetes. Together, we explore the challenges, triumphs, worries, and unexpected moments of joy that come with parenting a child with T1D.
Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and stories from our community, we're building a place where no parent has to feel alone on this journey.
Because life with Type 1 isn't just about numbers—it's about everything that happens in between. 💙

title: Overheard In The Emergency Room
author: Dr Adrian Cois MD
description:
An emergency physician steps out of the resuscitation bay to talk about what really keeps you out of it. 
Each episode breaks down food, movement, sleep, stress, and the systems around us into clear, practical steps for living a longer and better life. 
No shame, no biohacking gimmicks - just evidence, stories from the ER, and habits you can actually stick with.

author: Adam Hill (LCSW), Emily Goldberg, Neil Stratman
description:
‘I Dreamed a Dream…Then Checked My Email’ is a podcast exploring the intersection of mental health and the performing arts through honest conversations, personal stories, and professional perspectives. 
Hosts Adam Hill (psychotherapist/LCSW) and Emily Goldberg (performer & mental health enthusiast) chat with creative guests about the highs, lows, unexpected turns, and deeply personal experiences that shape a life in the industry. 
At its heart, this show is about helping people feel less alone on their artistic journeys. Whether you're a seasoned professional, an aspiring artist, a therapist, a mental health fan, or someone just figuring out what comes next, there's a seat on the couch for you.       
This podcast contains occasional strong language and candid conversations. While one of our co-hosts is a licensed psychotherapist, this is not a substitute for professional mental health care.

From our Extra Slice conversations and Sunday teaching to interviews, reflections and special events, STG+ is a place to explore faith, dig a little deeper into the Bible and discover what following Jesus looks like in everyday life.
Whether you’re part of St George’s, exploring faith, or simply curious — you’re very welcome here.

title: Final Cuts

description:
You're stranded on a desert island. You can only bring three horror movies. What are you taking, and why?
Join host Matthew Jackson as he interviews experts and enthusiasts from around the horror and film worlds to get their desert island horror movie picks. This is Final Cuts.

title: The Safety Corner With Desmond King
author: Desmond King
description:
The Safety Corner with Desmond King brings you inside the game—and into life after the lights. The former Iowa Hawkeye and NFL defensive back shares his perspective on Iowa football, the NFL, and what happens when the uniform comes off. From the pressure of covering a receiver alone to finding identity and purpose beyond athletics, Desmond talks football, family, business, and figuring out what’s next. Honest conversations, personal stories, and a competitor’s perspective on navigating life’s next chapter. Part of the 3 Beards Media network.
One man. One mic. One corner.

author: Dudley Anderson

title: Lost Hills
author: Pushkin Industries
description:
Lost Hills investigates the dark side of Malibu, California. Beneath a seductive facade, this city of billionaires, celebrities, and surf bums is hiding something menacing. Season 4: On September 16, 2009, 24-year-old Mitrice Richardson was arrested by the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department for failing to pay her bill at a restaurant in Malibu, CA. After being released from Lost Hills Station shortly after midnight, she disappeared. Eleven months later, her naked, skeletal remains were discovered in a canyon some six miles away. For nearly 15 years, the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department, Mitrice’s friends and family, and generations of internet sleuths have tried to crack the case. To this day, her death remains an unsolved mystery. The truth lies in the remote Malibu community where Mitrice was last seen. And now, finally, people are starting to talk. 
Season 3: There’s an evil undercurrent that runs through the surf world, and it all leads back to the Dark Prince of Malibu: Miki Dora. A surfer who ruled Malibu from the 1950s to the 1970s, he was also a con man and led the FBI on a 7-year manhunt around the world. To many people, Miki is a hero. But there’s darkness in the legacy he left behind.
Season 2: In January 1981, Verna Johnson-Roehler and her young son, Doug, drowned while boating thirty miles off the coast of Malibu. Verna’s husband, Fred Roehler, was the sole survivor and only witness. Initially, the deaths were ruled accidental. But a phone call from a Malibu neighbor changed everything. Was Fred a monster, masquerading as the perfect Malibu dad? Or was an innocent man convicted by his gossiping neighbors? 
Season 1: After Tristan Beaudette’s murder, other victims come forward telling similar tales. . . of a sniper in Malibu who has been shooting at campers and at moving cars for the past 18 months. Always in the dark of night, at 4AM. The cops say they can’t connect the crimes, but then they arrest a drifter: 42-year-old Anthony Rauda, who lives under a tarp behind the Lost Hills Sheriff’s Station. Is he the killer, or a scapegoat? Hosted by Dana Goodyear (The New Yorker) and produced by Western Sound and Pushkin Industries. Show artwork copyright Francesca Gabbiani.

title: License to Act
author: Luis Lancos and Antonio Vieira Santos
description:
Artificial intelligence agents are entering banking, payments, insurance and healthcare. Someone has to decide what they are allowed to do. 


License to Act talks to the executives, regulators and builders who make those decisions. They tell us where agents run inside their organisations today, how they govern them, and what it would take to become a Thinking Organisation: one that understands its own context well enough to improve how it works. 


Each episode places a guest somewhere on the road from assistants, to pilots, to processes that run end to end, to organisations where agents do the work and people step in where it matters. We look at that road through four questions. What gets redesigned in the processes, and what stalls? What happens to people, their roles, their skills, their trust and their fear? How much governance is enough, and does it scale? What do the rules assume, and where do they have no place for an agent? 


Every episode ends with the same question: who grants the license to act, who sets its limits, who monitors it, and who can take it away? 


Our guests work in banks, payment institutions, insurers, healthcare providers and charities, and they are accountable for the results. They talk about what works, what failed, and what they are still unsure about. There are no vendor pitches. 


Hosted by Luis Lancos and Antonio Vieira Santos. Sponsored by DataWhisper
