The word “real” here has a twofold meaning.

First, real Limmud Hachassidus. 

Topics will be learned and understood in a pure, authentic Chassidic style. Not watered down, altered, or dressed down using language and values that are foreign to Chassidus.

And second, real life. 

The topics will be learned and understood in a way that is practical, meaningful, real, and capable of changing the way we live. Chassidus cannot remain in the clouds; it must speak to us as human beings living in olam hazeh. It must transform, elevate, and infuse our daily lives and Avodas Hashem with chayus, bittul, meaning, authenticity and clarity.

From the oldest murder in the world to the forensic science that identifies the missing soldiers of a modern war, Bones is the story of the dead and of the living who read them. Meticulously researched, clear about the science of osteology and archaeology, and honest about the difference between the stories we tell about the dead and the evidence the bones themselves provide. This audiobook invites listeners to join Dickens as he explores the city’s hidden corners, meeting eccentric characters and revealing the untold stories of ordinary lives.

Every episode brims with intrigue, from the odd encounters with street performers to the poignant reflections on society's underbelly. Dickens doesn't just observe; he critiques and celebrates the human experience, all while crafting a rich narrative that is both entertaining and thought-provoking. What drives a man to become a flaneur, to seek stories in every shadow?

Listeners will discover the central conflict of navigating the complexities of urban life in an era of rapid change. Each story is a mini-journey, highlighting themes of social justice, identity, and the struggle for connection amidst the chaos of the city.

Prepare to be captivated as Dickens takes you on a unique exploration of London, blending humor, insight, and a touch of nostalgia. "Uncommercial Traveller" is more than just a collection of anecdotes; it's a window into a world shaped by the very streets you walk on, with surprises lurking in every tale. Dive in and unravel the mysteries of a bygone era through the eyes of one of literature's greatest observers.

Knot today, Captain! is your laid-back dive into the boating world, from what’s happening in the industry to legendary yarns from salty sailors, pirates, and all the wild ones in between. 
Whether it’s the latest boat tech, a bit of maritime history, or just a bloody good story, we’ve got you covered. Grab a cold one, kick back, and let’s chat all things boats!

title: The Bob Hope Show: Vintage Radio
author: Thomas
description:
Step back into the Golden Age of Radio with The Bob Hope Show: Vintage Radio, featuring newly remastered classic broadcasts from one of the most celebrated entertainers of the 20th century.

For decades, Bob Hope brought his unmistakable rapid-fire comedy, topical humor, music and Hollywood star power to audiences across America. These historic broadcasts capture Hope alongside an extraordinary lineup of guests and friends, including Bing Crosby, Judy Garland, Frank Sinatra, Lucille Ball, Doris Day, Jack Benny, Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis, Jimmy Durante, Dinah Shore, Peter Lorre, David Niven, Lana Turner, Betty Grable and many more.


Each episode has been carefully remastered to introduce these remarkable programs to a new generation while preserving the performances, personalities and atmosphere that made radio’s Golden Age unforgettable.


From Hollywood legends and musical icons to some of the greatest comedians of their generation, The Bob Hope Show: Vintage Radio is more than a trip down memory lane—it’s a chance to experience American entertainment history as audiences originally heard it.


Presented by Starboard Entertainment in cooperation with the Bob & Dolores Hope Foundation. Newly remastered episodes released regularly!

title: Pamela Hankins TV and Podcast
author: Pamela Hankins
description:
Pamela Hankins TV & Podcast is where faith meets transformation in love, life, and leadership.
Hosted by Pamela Hankins, this platform equips women—no matter their relationship status—to move beyond fairytales and into God’s divine design for identity, wholeness, communication, and connection.
Through powerful teaching, real conversations, and faith-centered insight, Pamela unpacks the truth about relationships, emotional intelligence, and spiritual growth. Whether you are single, dating, healing, or married, each episode meets you where you are—helping you break cycles, gain clarity, and wa

title: The Extreme Edge
author: Rae Boyce
description:
Real people. Real stories. High stakes in extreme environments.
I'm really glad you're here!
I’m a hiker and climber and I have a lot of respect for people who push their edge. 
These stories take a closer look at how people think, decide, and sometimes get it wrong.
Every story is researched, written, and voiced by a human person. 
Welcome to the eXtreme edge!

title: The Froggy and Ned podcast
author: The Froggy and Ned podcast
description:
Two mates, Football. Business. Zero filter.
Welcome to The Froggy and Ned Podcast. The wins, the losses, the money, the pressure, the mistakes, the characters. And the stuff nobody normally talks about.
Expect brutally honest opinions, heated debates, ridiculous stories big guests and plenty of laughs.
No scripts, no corporate waffle. No pretending we've got it all figured out.
Just Froggy and Ned and a couple of mics and a conversation that could go absolutely anywhere.
Follow the pod. Get involved!

title: The EB Effect Podcast
author: The EB Effect Podcast
description: 2 best friends of 12 years that are unfiltered & occasionally insightful, because apparently we had to share our convos with the world. Expect a lot of laughs, maybe a few tears, honest conversations, storytimes, unpopular opinions, and plenty of moments where we probably forget there's a camera recording us. We'll be talking about everything from friendship and navigating adulthood as women to nursing, motherhood, life experiences, growing up, figuring shit out as we go and whatever else ends up on the mic. No perfect scripts. No pretending we have it all figured out. Just two best friends being ourselves and letting you in on the conversation.

title: Charge to 100
author: Lloyd Evans and Colton Blomberg
description: Charge to 100 is the top resource for people who want to begin charging their path forward to success with intention and confidence but may not know where to start.

Watch and listen as they blend sarcasm and sports to bring you fresh takes twice a week, every week (unless one of them is busy that week). 99% sports, 1% mystery.

title: npnHub Podcast - Neuroplasticity in Practice
author: npn Neuroplasticians
description:
Where Applied Neuroscience Comes to Life

What happens when neuroscience moves from theory into practice?

The npnHub Podcast brings you conversations with Neuroplasticians and leading voices in applied neuroscience who are putting neuroscience and neuroplasticity to work in real-world settings. Through expert conversations, practical examples, and experiences from the field, we explore how neuroscience is being applied across coaching, leadership, education, organizations, human performance, behaviour change, and beyond.

Go beyond knowing the science and discover what it looks like to actually apply it, the approaches, challenges, insights, and lessons that emerge when neuroscience meets practice.

For practitioners, professionals, and anyone curious about the practical application of neuroscience and neuroplasticity.

title: WorkShift Podcast
author: ZaZa
description: A modern perspective on work, leadership, and career strategy. Hosted by ZaZa, WorkShift blends HR expertise with practical insight to break down workplace challenges from leadership and culture to performance and growth. Built for professionals who want to think strategically, lead effectively, and thrive in complex work environments.

title: Widow's Bay | Everything's Fine
author: Podcastica - Widow’s Bay
description:
Widow’s Bay is such a gem of a show, isn’t it? It’s so funny, and smart, and genuinely creepy and mysterious, and we couldn’t be more in love with this tale of a cursed New England island and the lovably quirky people who are stuck there.   
Ignore the warnings and join Jason and Karen as we examine the themes, characters, style, and backstory of this show (and also repeat most of the jokes and laugh).  
Everything’s Fine is a part of Podcastica, where we’ve been doing episode-by-episode deep dives into great TV for well over a decade now. Check out our other fare at ⁠Podcastica.com⁠.

title: Behind the founder

description: Matt Wright scaled his business to 500m in 6 years and sold for $120m. Now he’s sharing his knowledge to help fellow founders achieve their dreams

title: FILIPINA. AMERICAN. CREATIVE.
author: TESZ Millan
description:
Mabuhay and Welcome! FILIPINA. AMERICAN. CREATIVE. is my personal journey to rediscover my lost Philippine heritage.
What began as a documentary series on YouTube has taken me to unexpected places and into conversations that challenged what I thought I knew about where I come from – and helped me see my identity in new ways.
Now my series is also a podcast, bringing these conversations, stories, and discoveries to you wherever you watch or listen.
Come along as I keep asking questions and finding my way home to a heritage that was always mine – even when I didn't know how to find.

title: PitMom
author: Farran Tabrizi
description:
Pit Mom is about following the music. To the shows, the festivals, the tiny venues, the bands you’ve never heard of yet, and the stories you find along the way.
Hosted by filmmaker, mom, and lifelong live-music obsessive Farran Tabrizi, PitMom is part music discovery, part storytelling, and part excuse to keep showing up in the pit.
Expect festival adventures, artist conversations, venue love, new music, old favorites, and plenty of stories from a life built around chasing live music.
Follow the music. See where it takes you.

title: The Quant Finance Podcast
author: Assoc. Prof. (Practice) Nelson Lau, Nanyang Business School
description:
Quant finance from the people actually doing it.
The Quant Finance Podcast brings you conversations with traders, researchers, portfolio managers, risk professionals, founders and other leaders across the industry. We explore what they do, how they got there, how quant firms really work, and where the industry is heading.
Whether you’re looking to break into quant finance, understand the career paths and firms within it, or keep up with the ideas and trends shaping the field, this podcast is for you.

title: Punt Your Way Out!
author: The PYWO Mugs
description: This isn't just a podcast about getting on the punt. It's a show about getting together with your mates, getting down the pub, getting on the beers, and getting on the banter. It's about having a crack. It's about having fun. On our show good tips may golden - but entertainment is priceless. Join our triad of questionable pundits - the Guru, Mr $12.50, and Mr I Don't Know What The F--k I'm Doing - as they chat with industry experts, talk track, tips, wins and losses, and banter about how sh-t each other are at punting. title: The Strong Enough Fitness Podcast
author: Emily Lupian, M.S.
description:
The Strong Enough Fitness Podcast helps women in midlife cut through the noise around strength training, nutrition, fat loss, women’s health, perimenopause, menopause, and healthy aging so they can make confident decisions about how to train, eat, and take care of their bodies.
With honest conversations, evidence-based information, and practical advice you can actually use, you’ll learn how to build a sustainable approach to fitness that helps you feel strong, capable, and confident - and keep saying YES to the things you love for decades to come.

title: Path to Progress with Paul Heintzman and John Ackerman
author: John Ackerman and Paul Heintzman
description: In Path to Progress, John and Paul try to improve their lives by talking to awesome people.

title: The Diaspora Table
author: Monica Guillemin, PA-C, J.D.
description:
Hosted by Monica Guillemin, PA-C, J.D.—a clinician, scientist, published author and founder of Vision Harmony®—the podcast brings family, friends, professionals, community voices and fascinating people from across the diaspora to one table for candid conversations, sometimes wonderfully unpredictable.  Discussions on family and ancestry, health and wellness, culture and community, relationships and family conflict, caregiving, money and inheritance, law and legacy, faith, history, science and technology, books, travel and the changing world around us.


Sometimes the conversation begins with one subject and ends somewhere no one expected. A family story can uncover history. A health experience can become a teaching moment. A disagreement can open a conversation about generations, culture or fairness. And a journey across the world can remind us how much our stories intersect.


With roots in the African American experience and branches reaching across cultures and continents, The Diaspora Table creates space for perspectives that may differ—but deserve to be heard.


Some conversations are joyful. Some are difficult. Some are educational. And some are the conversations families have avoided for generations.  Because the stories we inherit matter.  The knowledge we share matters.  


And every family is still becoming.

The Diaspora Table
Not your sanitized family story.

A Vision Harmony Voices production.

title: The Counter Narrative: News Unfiltered
author: Counter Narrative News
description: Welcome to The Counter Narrative: News Unfiltered. In a media landscape driven by hype and spin, we cut through the noise to deliver unbiased, fact-first journalism. We dig deep into the stories that matter, stripping away agenda to give you pure, objective truth—plus our signature segment of bold hot takes that challenge the status quo. No agenda, just raw facts and sharp commentary. Subscribe and get the news, unfiltered.

author: Out With The Girls
description:
Welcome to Out with the Girls — the group chat out loud.
Hosted by best friends Rebekah and Alana, Out with the Girls is where girls’ nights, dating stories, friendship, hot takes, and the kind of conversations that usually never leave the group chat come to life. From navigating dating and relationships to friendship drama, nightlife, growing up, leveling up, and the occasional story we probably shouldn’t be telling on the internet… nothing is really off limits. Expect unfiltered conversations, questionable decisions, lots of laughs, and two best friends figuring life out in real time.Whether you’re getting ready for a night out, driving home from one, or recovering the next morning — you’re officially one of the girls. 🥂

author: Regina Rausch
description:
RAISE Your Voice is a podcast connected to RAISE Consulting and Advocacy. Its central focus is special education parent advocacy, with real parent experiences, practical education, and careful examination of the records and reports that shape educational decisions.
The podcast can also touch on executive functioning, social skills, early intervention, transition, and related topics, but advocacy remains the through line. The goal is to help families understand the process, recognize important questions, and participate meaningfully in decisions about their children.

title: Inner Thoughts of a Swim Coach

He didn’t start his career as a transformational coach. He started it drowning in anxiety, hiding behind a mask, and trying to outrun a version of himself he couldn’t stand.

What began in 2006 as a desperate attempt to feel confident spiraled into a global controversy in 2014... A media scandal that stripped him of his identity, shattered his ego, and forced him to confront the parts of himself he’d been avoiding for years.

That’s where the real work began. Not with mindset tricks, but by facing the insecurities and conditioning that had been running his life.

Today, his work reaches millions through live events, online programs, and his method Transformation Mastery, helping people let go of old weight and return to who they were before fear took over.

title: One Good Post: Local Marketing for Small Service Businesses
author: Coach Cynthia- Contently Well

One Good Post is local marketing for small service businesses run by women with their hands full. Every week, Cynthia Zilke breaks down one piece of content that's working and shows you how to make your own version for your cleaning business, esthetics studio, organizing business, or fitness classes.
No posting every day. No chasing viral. Just staying findable on Instagram and Google, so the right local clients book you when they're ready.
Cynthia is a millennial mom, caregiver, and the voice behind Contently Well, with 10 years of helping local businesses get found.

title: Natalia's Romanian
author: Natalia's Romanian
description:
Do you want to learn Romanian but you find it difficult because all the content is in Romanian only? Welcome to Natalia's Romanian Podcast!

I am Roberta-Natalia, or just Natalia and I have been teaching Romanian to foreign students from all over the world from England to USA.

title: How to End a War
author: Munck Studios København

If you’re navigating purpose, healing, or simply trying to stay centered in a noisy world, this podcast gives you a moment to pause, reset, and feel spiritually seen — one song, one story, one revelation at a time.

description:
What’s In Store: Making Sense of Modern Retail
What’s In Store is a retail learning series that goes inside the places, businesses and ideas shaping modern retail. We explore what retailers are doing, why they’re doing it and what others can learn. From retail technology and AI to stores, customer experience, ecommerce, operations and emerging business models, each episode takes you inside a real retail story and unpacks what makes it work.
Real retail. Real people. Practical learning.

Hosted by Elisabeth Zocca McBride, each episode brings together professionals, researchers, clinicians and innovators to share knowledge, experience and different perspectives — creating dialogue across disciplines and contributing to a more informed evolution of the profession.

description:
NephSpace makes new kidney research easy and fun to follow.

Every week, a practicing nephrologist picks the most interesting new papers and news in nephrology, and two hosts talk them through: the story, the key numbers, why it matters, and an honest take on what the study does and doesn't prove.

Weekly episodes (about 30 minutes) cover that week's picks from the kidney journals, the big general journals and the specialty news. Deep Dives (15 to 20 minutes) follow one question further: two treatments racing for the same goal, a trial worth arguing about, a case that a new paper answers.

Made for nephrologists, nephrology fellows and kidney-care clinicians. Curious, evenhanded, never condescending.

Physician-led, AI-assisted. Dr. Wael Hussein, an academic nephrologist in Memphis, chooses every paper, reviews and edits every script, and approves every episode. First drafts are written with AI from the full text of each paper, a separate AI check compares every number with the papers, and the hosts' voices are AI-generated. Authors' industry ties are named on air, and Dr. Hussein's own disclosures are in every episode's notes.

Educational content for healthcare professionals, not medical advice. Views are the creator's own and not those of his employer. Papers are summarized in our own words, with links to the originals.
